name: 2019 NYC School Survey - Student
description:
This dataset contains results from the 2019 New York City School Survey, reported at the school level for 1,829 sampled schools. Each row represents one school, identified by its district-borough-number code (dbn) and school name. The data include parent, teacher, and student response rates, along with survey-based scores on several dimensions of school quality: collaborative teachers, effective school leadership, rigorous instruction, strong family-community ties, and trust. Scores generally range from 1 to 5, with higher values indicating more favorable perceptions.

Several data quality issues are worth noting. The student response rate column is stored as text with percent signs (for example, "9500%") and is missing for about 39% of rows, so it would need cleaning before analysis.
